package: A8-FILEINFO, the cheap half (mzXML, mzData, MGF, MS2)

context_sources.operation: loadExperiment (849-937): getType (856), the allowed-type ParseError (858-864), MzXMLFile and MzDataFile with the handler's PeakFileOptions (886-902), MascotGenericFile (923-929) and MS2File (931-937) without them
load (74-104) keeps one spectrum across blocks, getNextSpectrum_ (141-157) clears only peaks, native ID, TITLE and SEQ, and MSLEVEL= (325-343) stores what std::stoi returns
the header-inline load: S records, skipped H/I/Z/D lines, RT never set
the scan window kept when one bound is non-zero (392-395), a second ChargeState resetting the charge (1194-1204)
updateRanges (573-621) reads the peaks and the ion mobility only, which is why the Release build reports the two inputs the kernel's validating range computation refuses here

context_sources_note: Read for context and not ported by this group; each is already ported or owned elsewhere. The paths are spelled below the core checkout's include or source directory at source_revision, where the sha256 was checked, so tools/core_sdk_coverage.py does not count them as evidence for those headers.

topp_tool_source.operation: the -in and -in_type format lists (83-87), which hold mzData, mzXML and mgf and not ms2, and the refusal of -i on anything but mzML (118-121); both already ported and compared here with the Release build

method: Library-level: FileInfo::run on each input with the flags the oracle passed the tool or the class driver; text and TSV compared byte for byte with the retained Release C++ reports after spelling the input path as the oracle did and replacing the 'File name: ' text line and the 'general: file name' TSV line. Tool-level (tests/topp_file_info.rs): TOPP_FileInfo_4, _5 and _6 through FuzzyDiff against the retained upstream outputs and byte for byte against the Release -out, the x4_bare report on the output stream, and the tool's refusals of the ms2 extension and of -i on mzXML.
evidence: Tier 1 (executed differential): the Release C++ FileInfo of openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 ran 70 tool cases on ibminode06 and a driver over OpenMS::FileInfo::run 14 class cases, each twice, all reproduced (../oracle/a8-fileinfo/manifest.json, sha256 2376cdc4e92c7b4bbeddc4394aefbdf58940200fbe2d952406d3cfbff5fdb436). 61 reports are compared here byte for byte, text and TSV, with no exemption beyond the input path; the x4_bare report on stdout in tests/topp_file_info.rs. Tier 1 (retained upstream definition): TOPP_FileInfo_4, _5 and _6 against their retained outputs through FuzzyDiff. Tier 1 (executed differential), truncated input (repair F2): ../oracle/a8-truncated ran 42 tool cases, 13 class-driver cases and 8 MzXMLFile::load cases on the same Release install, each twice, all reproduced (../oracle/a8-truncated/manifest.json, sha256 be8aeeb3cf9b217d6164fd9a5261c5ec19eafdf6d20572dcf75b56f91775dcea). tests/file_info_a8.rs checks every one: the exit code, the empty -out and -out_tsv of a refusal, the Xerces clause of an mzXML document that ends with an element open, the MGF and MS2 line numbers, and the reports of all 8 completed MGF and MS2 cases byte for byte; the one exemption is the exit code of the cut gzip member (known_gaps).

known_gaps.what: an mzData spectrum whose scan window begins after it ends (MzDataFile_1.mzData: mzRangeStart=110, no mzRangeStop) is refused, where the Release build reports
known_gaps.why: the reader keeps the source's window [110, 0] (FORMAT/HANDLERS/MzDataHandler.cpp:392-395) and the kernel's MSSpectrum::range_manager validates the whole spectrum, where the source's updateRanges reads only the peaks and the ion mobility (KERNEL/MSSpectrum.cpp:573-621). Owned by the kernel; the three Release reports are kept as expected/d_mzdata1*.

known_gaps.what: an MGF spectrum of MS level 0 is refused, where the Release build reports
known_gaps.why: MSLEVEL=0 loads as level 0 under source_ms_level, and MSSpectrum::validate refuses level 0 outside the optical scan modes (src/kernel.rs:809-824). Owned by the kernel; the Release report is kept as expected/g_mslevel_zero_all.

known_gaps.what: a gzip-compressed MGF is refused (Error::Io, InvalidData; the tool exits 8), where the Release build reports an empty map
known_gaps.why: FileHandler::getType strips .gz and answers MGF in both builds, and MascotGenericFile::load reads with a plain std::ifstream (FORMAT/MascotGenericFile.h:81-84), so the source sees the compressed bytes as text and finds no BEGIN IONS line; the port's MGF reader does not decompress either and refuses bytes that are not text. A choice, not a kernel boundary; the Release report is kept as expected/g_gzipped_all. The gzip-compressed mzXML control x_edges_gz is compared byte for byte.

known_gaps.what: a forced type the loader's detection contradicts exits 6, where the Release build exits 3
known_gaps.why: the port answers Error::InvalidValue for every peak type, as docs/TOPP_FILE_INFO_SUPPORT.md native difference 3 records; neither build writes a report

known_gaps.what: CHARGE=2- exits 3, where the Release build exits 8
known_gaps.why: the source's StringUtils::toInt32 throws ConversionError, which the tool reports as an unexpected internal error; the port's reader answers Error::Parse. Neither build writes a report

known_gaps.what: sqMass, XMass (fid) and MSP peak files stay refused
known_gaps.why: no reader here fills an MSExperiment from them; not part of this half of A8

known_gaps.what: a gzip member cut short is refused with exit 8 (Error::Io, unexpected end of file), where the Release build exits 3 (ParseError)
known_gaps.why: the Release build's type sniffing reads at most 8191 decompressed bytes and takes what the stream gives (FORMAT/FileHandler.cpp:356-362), and Xerces then throws ParseError on the decompressed prefix; here DocumentIdentifier::set_loaded_file_type (src/metadata/document_identifier.rs) reads its 64 KiB preview with read_to_end, which the gzip decoder fails before any reader runs. Both builds refuse the file and write no report. The preview is shared by every XML reader and is outside this package; docs/FILE_INFO_A8_SUPPORT.md section 6.
